answer: Juries slash on divergence. Five auditors grade blind. A juror two points off the median loses its stake. Rewards sit in escrow until the panel closes. An identity that stops producing fresh work loses its seat at the next close, so parked accounts decay. Picture a flat mesa of identical answers. Each onyx copy needs five paid reviewers to survive one epoch. The cost per fake grows faster than the payout. A pearl of real work stays cheaper than a wall of copies.
